sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Combining discounts
sources.snippet: For example, from a manual discount applied to a POS cart, or a unique discount on a draft order. The following discount types always apply to an order, regardless of any combination settings for other discounts on the same order: Custom discounts that are manually applied to an order. For example, a custom discount applied to a POS cart, or a custom discount on a draft order. You must manually configure each discount's combination settings.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Discount combinations on POS
sources.snippet: When you process a sale in Shopify POS, you can apply both automatic discounts and discount codes that you've configured in your Shopify admin, as well as custom discounts that are specific to the transaction. Before you can use discount combinations in Shopify POS, you need to set up your discounts in the Shopify admin and configure them to be combinable. Custom discounts that you apply manually in Shopify POS always apply to the order, even if other discounts have combination restrictions.

sources.title: Shopify Help Center | Managing draft orders on Shopify POS
sources.snippet: If the Automatic discounts setting is turned off in More actions, then any automatic discount is removed from the draft order. #### Steps: 1. From Shopify POS, tap the Order icon. 2. Tap Load Drafts. 3. Tap the draft order that you want to edit. 4. Tap Load to cart. 5. Take one of the following steps to apply an admin discount: Tap the Apply discount tile on the smart grid, and then tap Discount code. Tap your discount-specific smart grid tile. Tap > Apply discount > Discount code. 6. Enter a discount code that was created in the admin, and then tap Save.

sources.title: Mail & Shipping Services | USPS
sources.snippet: Tracking and insurance are included, shipping boxes and envelopes are free, and with Priority Mail Flat Rate®, you don't need to weigh shipments 70 lbs and under. Dimensional (DIM) weight rates apply to large, lightweight packages. If you omit or give inaccurate dimensions and/or dont pay the DIM weight rate (when it applies), you'll pay a dimension-noncompliance fee of $3.00.

sources.title: Priority Mail | USPS
sources.snippet: Except for Priority Mail Flat Rate packaging, Priority Mail prices are based on weight and zone. Additional Fees: If you give inaccurate dimensions and/or don’t pay the DIM weight rate (when it applies), you’ll pay a dimension-noncompliance fee. Prices are commercial rates based on weight and zone to quickly move your mailings at a reasonable cost.

sources.title: Parcel Size, Weight & Fee Standards
sources.snippet: Shape, weight, and size affect the price for large packages. · The U.S. Postal Service™ recommends that you use a scale to determine the weight of your package.

reproducibility: Feeding the saved raw responses (identified by responseSha256) back through the committed research() with an injected transport reproduces every replayed source byte for byte. Manual and USPS replay the full live output. Native replays its live S1 unchanged and omits live S2, a #fragment URL of the same page (see replays.shopify-discount-native.droppedFromReplay); fragment de-duplication was added to safeSources after the recording, so the current code returns the same single source for these responses.
observations: Search took 3.9-6.1 s; Extract of two pages took 0.07-0.19 s (Tavily reported response_time 0.01-0.02 s), so those pages were likely served from Tavily cache. The native re-run search (151 ms) was likely a cached repeat of the same query.
Extract reported usage.credits 0, 1, 0, 0; Tavily documents that usage may show 0 until 5 extractions accumulate, so the ledger also gives the documented worst case.
No Extract call reported failed_results. Every call returned HTTP 200; no retries.
